name: Wanjiru Kamau
headline: QA / Test Automation Engineer
summary: QA Automation Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks for web and API applications. Skilled in Selenium and Python, with hands-on experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines to improve release quality and speed. Strong collaborator with cross-functional development teams in agile environments.

responsibilities: Design and maintain Selenium-based automated test suites for web applications
Integrate automated tests into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery
Collaborate with developers to identify and troubleshoot defects early in the development cycle
Write and execute API test cases using Postman and Python requests library
Mentor junior QA staff on automation best practices
Executed manual and automated regression testing for e-commerce platform releases
Developed Python scripts using Pytest to automate repetitive test cases
Participated in sprint planning and reported defects using JIRA
Assisted in setting up initial CI/CD workflows for test automation
Performed manual functional testing of internal business applications
Logged and tracked bugs using test management tools
Supported senior QA staff in creating test plans and test cases
